announcement.msg_id: ARA 4.3.0 sudah tersedia — 43 preset bawaan kini lengkap (kamera, jam, material, staffage, grade), preset baru untuk Visualization Mode, dan perbaikan tampilan AURUM shell. Kalau kamu tidak melihat tawaran update otomatis, unduh manual di github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases — versi masa coba dan edisi portable memang tidak dapat update otomatis.
announcement.msg_en: ARA 4.3.0 is available — all 43 built-in presets now ship a complete photography kit (camera, time of day, material, staffage, grade), new Visualization Mode presets, and AURUM shell visual polish. If you don't see an automatic update prompt, download it manually at github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases — trial installs and the portable edition don't receive automatic updates.
